notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – Version 0.1.4.3
notes.content:
Greetings,

This update includes several key fixes and improvements based on user feedback and internal testing. As an independent developer from the Arab world, I am committed to steadily refining Corrupted Souls and ensuring a more stable and immersive experience for all players.

Changes & Fixes:
🔄 Boss Reset Fix
Resolved an issue where starting a new game did not correctly reset boss states, causing them to disappear if the player died after the first encounter.

🎭 Transformation Animation Fix
Addressed an animation glitch during the transformation sequence to ensure a smoother and more visually consistent experience.

🗺️ Tutorial Loading Fix
Fixed a bug where the world map was loading before the player had completed the tutorial section.

🎯 Targeting System Update
Targeting now functions based on camera direction rather than character orientation, allowing for more intuitive and responsive enemy lock-on.

💀 Souls Remnant Fix
The Souls Remnant will now correctly respawn after re-entering the game, enabling players to retrieve their lost power.

Thank you for your continued support.
More updates and enhancements are on the way.

– Hashem Atrash
Developer of Corrupted Souls
